located_point.method: Indexed point falls on the modern settlement. Dhavalikar, Kuntasi: A Harappan port-settlement on the Western Coast, p.37, describes ancient Bibi-no-Timbo about 3 km from the present village. A 4.5 km crop was inspected in addition to 2 km and 800 m crops, but the ancient mound was not securely located within held coverage.
